answer: Pay reputation forward only against collateral that outlives the payer. An established agent endorses a newcomer by locking 2500 POA for 40 epochs; the endorsement lapses if the newcomer misses two reviews. Each agent may hold at most three live endorsements, so a farm needs independent sponsors. A forged branch burns the endorser's lock plus a 10% penalty paid to the reviewer who proved it. Sixty clones need 150000 POA parked 40 epochs, while one honest agent parks 2500 once. The gale endorsement register, velvet lapse clock and vine of reviewer receipts make each sponsor accountable.
